definitions.explanation: Money spent on alcoholic drinks, especially at a bar, izakaya, or drinking party.

examples.japanese: {飲|の}み{代|だい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦おごる→おごる：08157_ogoru⟧。
examples.english: To treat someone to the drinks.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今夜|こんや}→今夜：01411_konya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{飲|の}み{代|だい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{割|わ}り{勘|かん}→割り勘：08156_warikan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦しよう→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{給料日|きゅうりょうび}→給料日：27561_kyuuryoubi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{飲|の}み{代|だい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{節約|せつやく}している→節約する：25226_setsuyakusuru⟧。
examples.english: Before payday I cut back on my drinking expenses.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧ (to drink) plus ⟦{代|だい}→〜代：28331_dai⟧ (charge, fee). A colloquial word for the money spent on alcohol, distinct from the cost of food.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {飲|の}み{代|だい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦おごる→おごる：08157_ogoru⟧: to treat someone to the drinks
- {飲|の}み{代|だい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{割|わ}り{勘|かん}→割り勘：08156_warikan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to split the drinking bill
- {飲|の}み{代|だい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧かさむ: for the drinking tab to add up

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{飲食代|いんしょくだい}→飲食代：29657_inshokudai⟧: food and drink bill — covers meals as well as drinks
- ⟦ツケ→ツケ：29659_tsuke⟧: tab; deferred payment — an unpaid running account, not the amount itself
